articles.summary: We are thrilled to announce that GrubMarket has completed the acquisition of SPUD (Sustainable Produce Urban Delivery), a leading Canadian online grocery company known for its deep commitment to the local sourcing of high-quality food. This strategic acquisition expands GrubMarket’s B2C eCommerce reach across British Columbia and Alberta, strengthening our presence in key Canadian markets […]
articles.title: GrubMarket Acquires SPUD, a Leading Canadian Online Grocery Company
